canada.title: Supreme Court of Canada dismisses bid to appeal B.C. foreign buyer tax case
canada.summary: The Supreme Court of Canada won’t hear an appeal challenging the application of British Columbia’s foreign buyer tax on a real estate purchase involving joint ownership by a Canadian citizen and a foreign national.

canada.title: Shelter-in-place advisory issued for Pemberton Valley, parts of Squamish as flooding closes roads
canada.summary: Shelter-in-place advisories have been issued in the Pemberton Valley and parts of the District of Squamish as flooding threatens local properties and roads. Líl̓wat Nation expanded an evacuation order for its community Thursday morning.
canada.outlet: CBC News, Global News + APTN News, CP24

canada.title: Jewelry store robbery ring that wreaked havoc this year dismantled, say Montreal police
canada.summary: Montreal police say they have broken up a ring allegedly responsible for the majority of smash-and-grab robberies targeting jewelry stores in the region, arresting more than a dozen people on Wednesday.

canada.title: Crestwood residents fear 8-plex ‘sandwiches’ being fast-tracked before provincial deadline
canada.summary: Crestwood residents fear builders and the City of Edmonton are racing the clock, trying to approve infill developments before a January deadline to roll back housing bylaws.

canada.title: Saskatoon officer hit by vehicle during traffic enforcement recovering from serious injuries
canada.summary: Police say the incident happened in the southbound lanes of Circle Drive near 108th Street around 1:15 p.m. on Wednesday, after the officer left his vehicle.

canada.title: Pilot killed in Remembrance Day crash had lifelong passion for flying, friends say
canada.summary: Friends of Daniel Parent — the man killed in a plane crash during a Remembrance Day event in Saint-Georges-de-Beauce, Que., — are remembering him for being an excellent and experienced pilot.

canada.title: Lawyers for Calgary man accused of working for Ryan Wedding say U.S. should not be allowed to prosecute
canada.summary: Defence lawyers fighting the extradition of Allistair Chapman, who is accused of working for alleged cartel kingpin Ryan Wedding, say he should not be sent to the United States to face charges for alleged crimes that took place in Canada, and doing so amounts to “cherry picking” the jurisdiction with the stiffer punishments.

canada.title: Here comes Santa Claus — and multiple road closures Saturday for Winnipeg parade
canada.summary: Santa's coming to town — and bringing with him many road closures to downtown Winnipeg this weekend.

canada.title: ISC minister says she was not expecting Kinew’s comments about abolishing the Indian Act
canada.summary: Mandy Gull-Masty says she was surprised when Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew raised the idea of abolishing the Indian Act at a meeting.

canada.title: A PAL Airlines flight lost a wheel less than 2 weeks ago. It's happened again — to the same plane
canada.summary: Less than two weeks after a PAL Airlines flight lost a wheel, the airline has confirmed the same plane lost another one Thursday. Flight 411 was bound for Deer Lake, Newfoundland and Labrador, but instead landed in St. John's.

canada.title: Coalition opposed to fossil-fuel projects hopes to boost Acadian voices in the debate
canada.summary: Coalition hopes to fight shale gas fracking and Tantramar gas plant, among other developments, and give francophones a platform for trying to influence policy.

canada.title: City orders removal of smaller Saskatoon encampment on 20th Street
canada.summary: Station 20 West says that despite warning from fire department to address an encampment on its property by Nov. 27, the organization, which helps unhoused people, has no intention of helping to displace about 30 people living in tents.

canada.title: Program that supports seniors living at home expands in rural New Brunswick
canada.summary: A new program in rural New Brunswick is bringing some of the benefits of a nursing home directly to the community.

canada.title: Lorne Doerkson sends letter to outgoing NDP government about Massey Tunnel project
canada.summary: Premier-designate Lorne Doerkson has committed to replacing the tunnel with a bridge, despite work on a new tunnel already being underway.

canada.title: Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne says Canada can build energy for AI, as Canadians protest against data centres, Bill C-39
canada.summary: Champagne was in Halifax on Thursday for an event with the Halifax Chamber of Commerce.
canada.outlet: Halifax Examiner, CBC News, APTN News (CP)

canada.title: Halifax-area teacher charged in child luring investigation
canada.summary: A 33-year-old man has been charged in connection with a child luring investigation. Police say they believe there are other victims who were targeted online.

canada.title: Winnipeg School Division delays giving parents report cards until teacher conferences
canada.summary: Manitoba's largest school division is taking a new approach to annual parent-teacher meetings, which will now happen before a student's report card is handed out.

canada.title: Alberta man charged with luring, sexually exploiting B.C. girl he met on gaming platform
canada.summary: A 19-year-old Alberta man is facing multiple charges, including child luring and child sexual exploitation, following an investigation into his alleged interactions with a British Columbia girl on an online gaming platform.

more.title: How Scott Colom won his longshot bid to flip Mississippi's Senate seat
more.summary: In Mississippi, Democrat Scott Colom won his longshot bid to oust incumbent Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith. Colom’s victory is a stunning reversal in the deeply conservative state that hasn’t been represented by a Black senator since the Reconstruction era following the Civil War. Liz Landers reports.
